title: THE CROSS AND THE GLORIOUS LIFE

memory_verse.label: Memory Verse
memory_verse.text: "The thief does not come except to steal, and to kill, and to destroy. I have come that they may have life, and that they may have it more abundantly." (John 10:10)

devotion.label: Insight / Reflection
devotion.text: When a father went to a cathedral with his young son, the boy pointed at the cross on the altar and asked, "Daddy, what is that big plus sign up there?" To this, the father replied, "If anyone thinks that Christianity subtracts something from our lives, it is a huge mistake; rather, it is a big plus sign that adds everything essential for our spiritual and worldly life. The cross is what brings together the lost human being with God. It is the cross that forgives sin meaning it subtracts sin and adds purification to make us holy. It is this cross that regains and restores for us the path to heaven. Just as those bitten by vipers in the wilderness lived when they looked at the bronze serpent lifted up by Moses, so we too receive life when we look with faith upon Jesus who was lifted up on the cross of wood during our entanglement in the temptation of sin. When the bronze serpent was lifted up in the wilderness, life was added to the people. Similarly, even if we are caught in the sin-temptation of Satan, we survive when we look upon the Lord Jesus on the cross. In short, Christianity in every aspect is an abundant blessing to us. It is receiving all helps and additional graces from God through His grace". Yes, the religion of Jesus Christ is the greatest plus sign that adds all soul and body benefits to our lives.

quote.label: Today's Quote
quote.text: "Christianity is a big plus sign that adds the best there is to our lives."

prayer.label: Prayer

conclusion.label: A Word to You
text: May the grace and peace of God be with you. Live daily with joy, remembering the love of the cross.
